extensions.description: This extension provides examples of the azd extension framework.

providers.name: demo
providers.description: Provisions infrastructure using the demo provider

examples.name: context
examples.description: Displays the current `azd` project & environment context.

examples.name: prompt
examples.description: Display prompt capabilities.

examples.name: ai models
examples.description: Browse available AI models interactively.

examples.name: ai deployment
examples.description: Select model/version/SKU/capacity and resolve a deployment configuration.

examples.name: ai quota
examples.description: View usage meters and limits for a selected location.

examples.name: mcp
examples.description: Start MCP server with demo tools.

examples.name: copilot
examples.description: Interactive Copilot chat loop demonstrating CopilotService gRPC API.

examples.name: telemetry
examples.description: Report a sample usage event through the telemetry service.

extensions.description: Ship prompt, hosted, and voice agents with Microsoft Foundry from your terminal.

providers.name: azure.ai.agent
providers.description: Deploys agents to the Foundry Agent Service

examples.name: init
examples.description: Initialize a new prompt, hosted, or voice agent project.

examples.name: init-prompt-voice
examples.description: Initialize a new prompt voice agent.
examples.usage: azd ai agent init --kind prompt-voice --agent-name my-voice-agent

extensions.description: Browser-based inspector UI for locally running Foundry agents.

examples.name: launch
examples.description: Launch the inspector against a local agent on the default agent port (8088), serving the inspector UI on the default inspector port (8087).

examples.name: launch with explicit ports
examples.description: Launch the inspector against a local agent on a custom port and serve the UI on a custom port.

extensions.description: Manage Microsoft Foundry Routines from your terminal.

providers.name: azure.ai.routine
providers.description: Upserts Foundry routines declared as azure.ai.routine services in azure.yaml

extensions.description: Manage Microsoft Foundry Connections from your terminal.

providers.name: azure.ai.connection
providers.description: Upserts Foundry connections declared as azure.ai.connection services in azure.yaml

extensions.description: Manage Microsoft Foundry Project resources from your terminal.

providers.name: azure.ai.project
providers.description: Owns the azure.ai.project host so azd can walk the Foundry project service in azure.yaml

providers.name: microsoft.foundry
providers.description: Provisions Microsoft Foundry projects from azure.yaml

extensions.description: Manage Microsoft Foundry Toolboxes from your terminal.

providers.name: azure.ai.toolbox
providers.description: Upserts Foundry toolboxes declared as azure.ai.toolbox services in azure.yaml

extensions.description: Manage Microsoft Foundry skills (reusable agent behavioral guidelines) from your terminal.

providers.name: azure.ai.skill
providers.description: Upserts Foundry skills declared as azure.ai.skill services in azure.yaml

examples.name: add
examples.description: Add a skill service to the current azure.yaml.

examples.name: list
examples.description: List skills in the current Foundry project.

examples.name: create
examples.description: Create a skill from a SKILL.md file.

examples.name: download
examples.description: Download and extract a skill into ./.agents/skills/.

extensions.description: Manage RLE resources from your terminal. Commands are hidden by default; set AZD_AI_RLE_ENABLE=true to enable them. (Preview)

examples.name: init
examples.description: Copy the OpenEnv echo sample into a local RLE environment.

examples.name: publish
examples.description: Build, push, and create or update the RLE environment.

examples.name: run
examples.description: Build and run the local RLE environment container.

examples.name: invoke
examples.description: Create a temporary RLE instance and open an OpenEnv runtime shell.

examples.name: list
examples.description: List RLE environments in a Foundry project.

examples.name: show
examples.description: Show the details and version history for an RLE environment.

extensions.description: Define and run Foundry evaluations from your terminal. (Beta)

providers.name: azure.ai.eval
providers.description: Deploys evaluation datasets, evaluators, and eval groups to Foundry

examples.name: init
examples.description: Scaffold evaluation config for an agent or completed conversations.

examples.name: run
examples.description: Start, list, and read the results of evaluation runs.

extensions.description: Register and version Foundry datasets from your terminal. (Beta)

examples.name: create
examples.description: Register a dataset from a local file.

examples.name: versions list
examples.description: List the versions of a dataset.
examples.usage: azd ai dataset versions list support-regression

extensions.description: Manage Search service from your terminal. (Preview)
